retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1980s-style geometric collage featuring stylized musical instruments and bold diagonal patterns in a pastel and primary color scheme.
triggerTerms: diagonal striped background with abstract shapes

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic, multi-layered composition where stylized, flat-color musical instruments like guitars and keyboards intersect with diagonal pink stripes and blue geometric fields. The style uses sharp angles, wood-grain textures, and a playful, non-literal approach to form.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal keyboard keys intersecting with a vertical guitar neck
Pink diagonal stripes contrasting against a solid blue triangular field
Stylized bird-like guitar body overlapping a textured background
Black dashed lines creating a sense of movement across the center
coreInvariants: Diagonal orientation of the keyboard element
Pastel pink and white striped background pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guitar neck acts as a central vertical axis, while the keyboard and stripes create a strong diagonal movement from bottom-left to top-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light-wood textured guitar body at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal keyboard upward, then circles through the abstract shapes and stripes back to the central guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with overlapping shapes and textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pastel Pink (stripes) and Sky Blue (background fields)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value pastels mixed with saturated primary accents and high-contrast black elements.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, hand-drawn quality with varying stroke widths
Letters follow a slight upward arc across the top
Characters are tightly packed with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' and 'G' are nearly perfect circles
The 'K' has a high waist and elongated legs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative display face used for all text elements to maintain a cohesive hand-drawn look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the playful, slightly irregular weight and energy.
Best matches the specific 80s DIY aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a geometric collage with a diagonal keyboard, a vertical guitar with wood texture, and a background of pink and white diagonal stripes and blue triangles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn, bold black uppercase lettering following an upward arc along the top edge of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the text arched along the top?
Is the guitar body textured like wood?
Are the keyboard keys black and white rectangles?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the blue and pink tones
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard, clean Helvetica or Arial
Do not use realistic 3D rendering for instruments
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the diagonal keyboard element.
Ensure the text follows a curved path.
Verify the wood-grain texture on the guitar.
Confirm the pink and white striped pattern is present.
Check that the overall composition feels like a collage.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [geometric musical instruments] + [diagonal pink stripes] + [arched hand-drawn sans-serif typography] + [80s pastel palette] to create a [New Wave collage aesthetic].
